description: This file defines a set of simple methods related to human resources event handling within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating and removing internal organizations, handling employee position fulfillment, and creating public holiday entries.

methods.name: createInternalOrg
methods.description: Creates an internal organization by establishing a party relationship between parties.

methods.name: removeEmlpPosition
methods.description: Removes an employee position fulfillment and the employee position itself.

methods.name: removeInternalOrg
methods.description: Removes an internal organization by deleting the associated party relationship.

methods.name: createPublicHoliday
methods.description: Creates a public holiday work effort, validating required parameters and associating a date range.
